role: Member of the Board of Directors
summary: Board-level governance of an insurance company: policy oversight, strategic direction and financial supervision.
responsibilities: Oversaw the company's policies and affairs to support its long-term success.
Carried out corporate governance duties, ensuring the company adhered to laws and ethical standards.
Provided strategic direction, setting goals and objectives aligned with the company's vision and stakeholders' interests.
Oversaw the company's financial health, including approving budgets and monitoring financial performance.

summary: Led a first-class (GC-1) road works enterprise across project delivery, contracts, safety and people.
responsibilities: Managed the entire lifecycle of construction projects, ensuring timely completion within budget and to quality standards.
Negotiated contracts with clients, vendors and subcontractors, defining terms, work scopes, timelines and payment schedules.
Coordinated cross-functional teams of architects, designers, consultants, purchase and administration staff, technical teams, contractors and supervisors.
Implemented and enforced safety protocols, maintaining compliance with health and safety regulations on construction sites.
Led the construction team through strategic hiring, training and performance evaluation.

summary: Ran a road maintenance district: crews, heavy equipment fleet, budget and inventory.
responsibilities: Supervised all operational aspects of the Road Maintenance District, allocating resources and personnel.
Directed daily activities, assigning tasks to assistant foremen, district mechanics and heavy equipment operators according to project requirements and conditions.
Managed a diverse workforce of full-time, part-time and seasonal employees.
Coordinated the maintenance and operation of the district's fleet of equipment, trucks and vehicles to keep them available and reliable.
Monitored and controlled budget expenditure, resource allocation and inventory.
Maintained clear communication with employees, vendors and buyers.

summary: On-site engineering for road construction: supervision, scheduling, cost estimates and materials.
responsibilities: Managed multiple aspects of construction projects, coordinating tasks to complete them within established timelines.
Supervised and led construction crews.
Provided technical guidance and recommended improvements to project outcomes.
Developed cost estimates for project components to support budgeting and financial oversight.
Secured the materials and tools needed on site, reducing potential delays.
Worked with construction teams and subcontractors, offering technical expertise on site operations.

summary: Coordinated community HIV/AIDS prevention projects and awareness programmes.
responsibilities: Oversaw all projects and activities related to HIV/AIDS within the assigned territory.
Developed and implemented projects addressing the challenges of communities affected by HIV/AIDS.
Implemented, monitored and maintained culturally relevant HIV/AIDS prevention strategies in line with organisational principles.
Promoted awareness campaigns and facilitated the formation of support groups and clubs in local institutions.

summary: Taught mathematics, mentored new teachers and contributed to curriculum materials.
responsibilities: Delivered mathematics instruction emphasising critical thinking and problem-solving.
Developed and executed lesson plans in line with educational standards.
Mentored new and junior teachers.
Led extracurricular programmes, including a debate club and a science fair.
Held parent-teacher conferences to support student success.
Contributed to the development of curriculum materials and classroom resources.
